title: Ainul
subtitle: You can possibly destroy a Fragment, but never Ainul when whole.
description: Ainul is the fully restored Whole One. Every Fragment, Fusion, emotion, concept, instinct, memory and aspect exists as a part of him. Whenever all twelve Fragments unite, the result is always Ainul in his complete form. No alternative outcome exists.
aspect: The complete and original being from which all Fragments originate.

sections.title: Fragmentation
sections.body: At an unknown point Ainul split into twelve essential Fragments, each embodying a core aspect of his existence.

sections.title: Reformation
sections.body: Only the presence of every Fragment allows complete restoration.

sections.title: Death
sections.body: According to Ainul himself, he is not immortal. He is literally incapable of dying.

sections.title: Form: Whole One
sections.body: The complete and balanced form of Ainul.

sections.title: Form: The Beast
sections.body: A hidden unleashed state possessed by Ainul and reflected in certain Fragment overclocks.
